summary.intent: Plan the legacy-retirement expansion of CipherBox phase 69 — author new plans (69-19 recycle-bin migration, 69-20 vault-creation migration) and rewrite 69-10 (delete legacy types) so the FUSE/node-v3 migration can fully retire the old folder/file metadata types.
summary.outcome: A planner subagent authored and validated three plan files (69-19, 69-20, rewritten 69-10) with clean frontmatter, dependency chains, and workspace-green boundaries; two deliberate deviations from the original brief were identified and accepted; plans were about to be committed and 69-19 launched.

repo: `cipherbox_core::folder::VersionEntry` cannot be deleted in 69-10 — `crates/fuse/src/helpers.rs` (`apply_versioning`/`versions_to_bin_entries`, unconditionally compiled) depends on it, so `folder.rs` must be reduced (keep VersionEntry, `pub mod folder;`) rather than emptied/removed.

`content_ops.rs::publish_file_metadata` is a live default-compiled consumer of `FileMetadata`/`encrypt_file_metadata` (winfsp-only caller, superseded by node/v3 `publish_file_node`) — must be deleted in 69-10 even though the original brief only listed `merge_folder_children`/`encrypt_metadata_to_json`, otherwise deleting `FileMetadata` breaks the default build.
No live Rust bin-restore command exists today — the recycle bin is write-only — so 69-19 must land restore *data* plus a pure re-splice round-trip test rather than a real restore command.

69-20 (vault-creation) uses the core seal path directly instead of `build_folder_emission`, because vault-creation needs HKDF-derived IPNS plus mount-consistent bridge keys: `root_read_key = root_folder_key[..32]`, `root_write_key = read ^ 0xA5` (see apps/desktop mod.rs:192-205), coupling it to phase-63 root-key recovery.

BinEntry reshape (69-19): drop `file_pointer`, `folder_entry`, `original_folder_key_encrypted`; add `child_published_node: String` (b64 encode_published_node), `child_ref: SealedChildRef` (read plane, keyed by ipnsName), `write_child_ref: WriteChildRef` (write plane, D-07, keyed by childId UUID via `uuid_from_ino`); keep the ECIES `encrypt_bin_metadata`/`decrypt_bin_metadata` envelope and `VersionCidEntry`/`BinItemType`/`RecycleBinMetadata`.

code.finding: Bridge key derivation for mount consistency: root_read_key = root_folder_key[..32]; root_write_key = root_read_key XOR 0xA5. 69-20 must replicate this instead of using build_folder_emission's random-key path.
apply_versioning/versions_to_bin_entries are unconditionally compiled and depend on cipherbox_core::folder::VersionEntry, blocking full deletion of folder.rs in 69-10.

workflow: Planning-only agent runs (opus planner) were scoped strictly to `.planning/` files with no source or ROADMAP.md edits — orchestrator commits and integrates afterward.

Plan validation checks frontmatter/task structure and flags a 'missing <files>' warning as acceptable when it matches sibling plans' established convention (per-task <read_first> + frontmatter files_modified).

friction: Planner run took ~19 minutes and 262K tokens for three plan files, a heavy planning cost before any implementation began.
Phase 69's plan count grew by +2 mid-phase (69-19, 69-20 added) — ROADMAP.md's plan list may now be stale and need manual updating.
